# Account storage pane names depend on server type and offline policy, not disk capacity

The cleanup removes supportsDiskSpace and makes AccountManager exclude IM by type. Other accounts use am-offline.xhtml with a synchronization or disk-space label. The fixed code constructs panel objects at their actual conditions instead of indexing a parallel list. The fixed source has a later EWS synchronization-title exception; it is not part of the capability removal. A panel title and source filename do not prove disk-capacity or offline-operation support. No settings UI or protocol matrix ran.

Scope: Account Manager panel routing.
